evidence: Adds the getscripthistory RPC method in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and refactors helpers in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.
rationale: Introduces getscripthistory to address a long-standing interface gap where callers cannot query transactions by script or address without importing them into wallet descriptors. Downstream software and external tools gain native script history queries with descriptor and ranged paging support.
